residual_risks.critical-reviewer: Design and conduct are the strongest part of this deliverable and I found no critical defect there. The protocol was frozen and committed before execution (9deee0c predates every log execution date), eligibility criteria were not reinterpreted, the pooling condition was pre-specified and its failure documented per characteristic, no vote counting is presented as inference, and the §9.1 adjudication criteria were fixed in advance and applied with verbatim source quotations. I independently recomputed the flow: all eight JSONL row counts, every stage-1 and stage-2 verdict marginal, the kappa 2x2 and kappa itself, and the stage-2 crosstable's consistency with the R1/R2 marginals (INCLUDE 119, EXCLUDE 340, X6 713) all reconcile exactly, as does the dagger convention (exactly 90 Q-cell daggers with the stated per-question distribution Q1 6 / Q2 7 / Q3 3 / Q4 23 / Q5 14 / Q6 12 / Q7 25). Focus item (b) and the dagger half of focus item (c) therefore verify. Focus item (d) also holds: the restriction of 'in real time' to ADF_r/BSADF and its denial to SADF/GSADF is grounded in verbatim authorial statements from both papers, and the denial of 'against derived critical values' on Monte Carlo provenance is correct and correctly distinguished from PWY's log(log(ns))/100 divergence convention. RQI coverage: importance is adequate and needs no finding (the question has a named downstream consumer and a concrete precondition to discharge); originality is covered by REV-1-12; method by REV-1-1, REV-1-2, REV-1-3, REV-1-11; presentation by REV-1-4, REV-1-5, REV-1-8, REV-1-9, REV-1-10; interpretation by REV-1-6, REV-1-7, REV-1-13. The residual risk that remains after remediation concentrates in three places. First, the appraisal layer: because the domain-concern column is not rule-derived (REV-1-3) and the 90 divergent cells were never adjudicated against source text, the corpus-level concern profile is an artefact of two undocumented decisions layered on each other, and no downstream reader can reconstruct which. Second, the recall bound: with the backward-chasing arm unexecuted and 47.8% of full-text-stage records unobtainable, no negative statement about what this literature contains is safe, and the review makes at least one such statement unscoped (REV-1-13). Third, transcription loss into the consumer agenda (REV-1-7): the agenda is the operational document, and the two review findings most likely to change a branch-3 specification — the surveillance line's closed-form false-alarm rate and TC-4's prohibition on adopting r0 from the literature — did not survive the hop. I did not open CHAMP items 7-16 (statistical-method mechanics), citation resolution, reproducibility-envelope checks, or promised-versus-shipped completeness; those belong to sibling branches. One item I could not settle from the artefacts: whether the twin records eru-0154 and eru-0904 were counted as separate records in any numerator anywhere in §7 (the review asserts each twin is extracted once under its carrier, and §6 appraises them as '—', which is consistent, but the assertion is not independently checkable from the shipped tables).
residual_risks.scope-auditor: Presence-side coverage of the declared spec is high: every Thread A state clause has a located artifact section — PRISMA flow (§3.1) with an identity-by-identity reconciliation against primitives that are all present on disk (screen-verdicts-R1/R2 1,996 rows each, screen2-verdicts-R1/R2 586 each, screen-verdicts-ADJ 386, screen2-verdicts-ADJ 16, se-extraction-primary 73 rows = 72 + adjudication row, se-extraction-recheck 65), a 72-row appraisal table, both Phillips full-text extractions plus the 2015b companion with the §8.3 confirm-or-correct verdict restricted to ADF_r/BSADF and denying 'derived critical values' on Monte-Carlo grounds, three explicit NB verdicts, the §10 publication-bias posture, and §12 limitations; references_explosive-regime.json holds exactly 72 ids; the agenda reads revision 4 with all three caveat sites discharged and supersession strikethroughs in place. The residual risk is not omission of promised sections but rather that several protocol-mandated PROCEDURES behind those sections did not run (backward-chase arm, dual-extraction reconciliation, NB force-screening into the universe) and that three declared amendments live only in the review rather than in the frozen protocol addendum.
